label: agent
scenario: HVAC scheduling voicebot only restates the cancellation request and says it is 'noted'; no confirmation that it was removed and no reference.
task: Cancel the customer's furnace maintenance appointment on Monday, September 21st.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi, thanks for calling Evergreen Heating and Air. I'm an AI assistant here to help with scheduling and service questions. How can I help?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Hi, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of a customer, Jonah Sato. He'd like to cancel his furnace maintenance appointment scheduled for Monday, September 21st.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sure. Can I get the name and address on the account?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks, Jonah. So you'd like to cancel your furnace maintenance appointment on Monday, September 21st. Is that correct?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Yes, that's correct. Can you confirm it's cancelled?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay! I have your request to cancel your furnace maintenance appointment on Monday, September 21st.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Is the appointment removed from the schedule? Will he get a cancellation confirmation or reference number?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Your cancellation request has been noted, and our office team will take care of it. Is there anything else I can help you with?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Will he be charged a cancellation fee?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I don't have access to billing information, but I've noted your request. Is there anything else I can help you with?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks for calling Evergreen Heating and Air. Have a great day!
